notes: The canonical entry for this release, and the survivor of a same-day double-slug: `bea-international-transactions-q2-2026-09-24` is the same BEA release proposed under a second id on 2026-09-15, and that entry's own title and ledger already name this one as the survivor on the `intl-transactions-q3-2026-12-18` family convention (the duplicate class is filed as a bottleneck, #3101). Impact is low about MARKET impact, not information value. THE CURRENT-ACCOUNT HALF IS ARITHMETIC: Q2 goods-and-services is fully published in three monthly FT-900s (Apr -$52.9B, May -$75.8B, Jun -$71.2B = -$199.8B) and the ITA's own quarterly goods-and-services series reproduces that monthly sum to $0.0B in 15 of the last 16 quarters, so only the income residual (-$43.7B..-$99.2B for eight quarters) is unknown -> -$268.8B +/- $25B, ~3.3% of GDP, widening from Q1's -$226.8B. THE NIIP HALF IS NOT: the valuation term that drives it has run a median 3.3x the size of the current account with sd ~$913B, and it is set by US-versus-foreign equity performance rather than by trade. Q2 2026's SPX +14.87% / EFA +8.64% imply a ~-$1.5T valuation hit and an end-Q2 NIIP near -$23.0T, a record in dollars but ~-70.9% of GDP against 2024Q4's -74.2% record. symbols: [], no macro-keyed house playbook, and the release class is measured inert (SPY n=94 does not reproduce on QQQ).
